summary: Interactive WebGL 3D particle galaxy simulation generated via a single Cursor prompt with parameter sliders and camera orbit.

post.originalText:
Gave Gemini 4 Argon one prompt in Cursor: build a 3D particle galaxy.

It came back with a live WebGL app. 85,000 particles at 120 FPS, sliders for arms, rotation speed and color scheme, mouse to orbit the camera. https://t.co/rDkVaKmvvy
